newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed in moderate trade on retail and interbank interest, dealers said on Friday.

"The interbank rate slipped slightly today but there was little impact on the market. Treasury bill yields were steady to slightly higher but bond prices were narrowly mixed. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.78/1.73 percent compared with Thursday's yield of 1.76/1.71 percent but one-year was unchanged from Thursday's yield of 1.58/1.53 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$99.28/99.33 against Thursday's close of S$99.29/99.34, September 2001 at S$99.36/99.41 from S$99.35/99.40 and June 2003 at S$99.05/99.10 versus S$99.07/99.12.
The overnight interbank offered rate slipped to 2-1/2 2-3/8 percent against Thursday's 2-3/4 2-5/8 percent.
